description: Versioned contract; parsed corpora must not silently change shape.
Globally unique stable record identifier within one export.
Exact source-object field and Unicode offsets supporting this record; raw source remains in ignored cache.
The layer represented by this entry; neither layer silently overwrites the other.
Object with LoC transliteration and Tibetan fields, preserving source Unicode. LoC is the historical Library of Congress system, not Wylie.
Zero or more source-witness identities; candidate identity must not be represented as a final entry link.
Foreign key to an entry record.
Source order within the entry.
Source-faithful definition text; presentation normalization, if any, belongs in a separately named derived field.

Source order within the sense.
Tibetan quotation/Belegstellung as preserved from the source.
German translation or gloss when the source provides one.
Foreign key to a citation record when a siglum/citation is identified.
Source-preserved citation siglum; normalization is explicit and never inferred by a broad OCR rule.
Foreign key to a bibliographic_source record.
Source-preserved citation locator.
Stable human-readable bibliographic source label.
Foreign key to the print-faithful or editorial entry being related.
Named structured field whose readings differ; not an unbounded prose replacement.
Reading in the declared base layer.
Reading in the related layer.
Relationship classification; OCR damage belongs in a correction-evidence ledger, not here.
Status of any needed print comparison.
Stable cached-object/article/PDF-run identifier.
SHA-256 of the exact unmodified cached response object.
Named parsed/decoded source field containing the span.
Zero-based Unicode code-point offset, inclusive.
Zero-based Unicode code-point offset, exclusive and greater than start.
